scope: Publish the exact candidate, then execute one CPU-only installed-runtime flag qualification. No model/weight load, Tensor computation, GPU entry, FlexGEMM/Triton execution, decoder alteration or retry.
preflight_record: PASS: exact probe guest path and compatibility helper anchors, source identity, exclusive marker/run absence, GPU_authorized=false and original named distro command verified.
focused_host_regressions: Five tests pass after the final one-line policy-phase change. They test independent queries, boolean types, environment preservation, negative acceptance gates and paths/helper anchor; they import no Torch.

flags_and_environment.pre_query_environment: Capture all PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_* keys, including explicit unset records for the three controlling keys, before Torch import and any flag query.
flags_and_environment.acceptance: Require independently recorded boolean before-values, all three after-values false, exact control order and unchanged environment. An environment override that retains true produces UNKNOWN and stops without environment fallback or retry.
flags_and_environment.source_basis: Captured installed source lines 170-179 document environment precedence/caching; lines 219-253 show the six exact wrappers calling their corresponding _C flag bindings with no Tensor or model operations.
flags_and_environment.result_limit: This qualifies process-local control behavior in the new worker. It does not retroactively identify the prior failed worker's unrecorded flags, persist settings into a future worker, or authorize a neural retry.

safety_and_containment.GPU_entry_denial: Python/C entry profiling is active before Torch import. Genuine _lazy_init and _cuda_init presence is mandatory; available real GPU entry methods are patched to record-and-deny. Qualification requires no calls and Torch initialization false before/after.
safety_and_containment.Tensor_denial: Final candidate uses unchanged ImportPolicy native_import phase and dispatch/frontend guards, denying every Tensor operation before execution. Qualification additionally requires zero Tensor/native/rejection counters.
safety_and_containment.other_scope_guards: Forbidden model/native imports, model-file access, network/process creation and writes outside owned scratch/evidence are rejected. No flag/tuning execution loop or real computation is present.
safety_and_containment.paths_and_marker: Own fresh scratch and run/guest paths. Exclusive CPU-tunableop.marker records the actual probe SHA and GPU_authorized=false. Host output is restricted to this evidence run directory.
safety_and_containment.helper_anchor: runner.SCRIPT selects only the probe; base.SCRIPT remains anchored at scripts/compatibility. Local preflight, qualifier, marker reservation and deadlines are adapted without changing the reused supervisor implementation.
safety_and_containment.supervisor: Retains exact binary GO, Job attachment before GO, healthy monitoring, owned-tree cleanup, named distro termination and post-exit observation. Stage/guest/host bounds are 60/90/120 seconds; one marker prevents another authorized sequence.
safety_and_containment.restoration: Original Tensor guards and GPU methods are restored and their identities checked. TunableOp settings are intentionally left at their qualified values only until this disposable process exits.
